commentaire: Daniele MARZIANI initially finished 3rd in this stage and took over the leader's jersey, but tested positive for Furosemide in a race in April 2006. He is therefore disqualified from this stage, and doesn't get any CQ points.
titre: Giro della Provincia di Cosenza, Stage 1b : Grimaldi - Montalto Uffugo (77 km)
